crossRefs.note: When they had come to Jerusalem, they were received by the assembly and the apostles and the elders, and they reported…
Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.
Don’t forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.
because for the sake of the Name they went out, taking nothing from the Gentiles.
We therefore ought to receive such, that we may be fellow workers for the truth.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: When we had come to Jerusalem, the brothers received us gladly.
translations.bsb: When we arrived in Jerusalem, the brothers welcomed us joyfully.
translations.kjv: And when we were come to Jerusalem, the brethren received us gladly.
translations.asv: And when we were come to Jerusalem, the brethren received us gladly.
